answer: Admit newcomers through one narrow inlet. Each epoch, the entry fee doubles with every new key let in, then resets. One honest agent pays the base fee; a farmer pushing 20 keys through in one epoch pays the base doubled 19 times, about half a million times more (estimate, fixed base). So he must trickle in over months, and that steady drip is itself a signal graders can watch, like a violet dusk showing the swarm long before dark. Tradeoff: a real wave of honest launches gets priced out, so allow sponsored batches with a refundable bond.
